items.title: Iceland votes against restarting talks on joining EU
items.description: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume talks.

items.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
items.description: Five others in their twenties were injured after shots were fired at a techno event near Zurich.

items.title: Large Lake Ontario sign installed in Canada in latest jab at US
items.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on Canada's shoreline with the message: "Lake Ontario. Now and Always."

items.title: WhatsApp chat used to send cash for crime and extremism
items.description: The WhatsApp money launderers arranged cash transfers in the UK and around the world with no paper trail.

items.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
items.description: An investigation has begun into the storage of weapons for Ukraine's military near a residential area.

items.title: Zambian opposition leader charged with treason
items.description: Mundubile had previously gone into hiding at a United Nations building in Zambia's capital.

items.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos deported from US to UK
items.description: The self-styled provocateur had been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

items.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
items.description: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

items.title: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
items.description: Haakon VIII pays emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V, before outlining how he wishes to reign.

items.title: Former Ecuadorian president imprisoned for corruption
items.description: Lenín Moreno denies taking bribes from a Chinese firm to secure a contract to build a hydroelectric plant.

items.title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
items.description: A woman who rented out homes to two al-Qaeda members speaks publicly for the first time - to the BBC.

items.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
items.description: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.
